rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for a robust conclusion, system, or response that is dependable and not easily disrupted.

example.english: This plan is robust and will not go haywire even when unexpected situations arise.
example.traditional: 呢個方案夠穩陣，遇到突發情況都唔會亂。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 gau3 wan2 zan6 jyu6 dou3 dat6 faat3 cing4 fong3 dou1 m4 wui5 lyun6

rows.note: Use this for a person or animal that is notably strong and healthy, especially when also physically large.

example.english: That dog is robust and does not get tired after walking in the mountains for several hours.
example.traditional: 嗰隻狗又大隻又健壯，行幾個鐘山路都唔攰。
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 gau2 jau6 daai6 zek3 jau6 gin6 zong3 haang4 gei2 go3 zung1 saan1 lou6 dou1 m4 gui6

rows.note: Use this when stressing that something can withstand adverse conditions, pressure, or rough treatment.

example.english: This machine is robust enough to withstand prolonged operation at high temperatures.
example.traditional: 呢部機頂得住長時間高溫運作。
example.jyutping: ne1 bou6 gei1 ding2 dak1 zyu6 coeng4 si4 gaan1 gou1 wan1 wan6 zok3
